name: Peltzer Pumpkin Farm
blurb: Fall pumpkin farm and attractions. No dogs. Weekday hours differ from weekends. Confirm tickets on the farm site.

name: Halloween Carnival & Trick-or-Treating
where: Temecula Civic Center and Old Town
blurb: City carnival plus participating Old Town businesses. Family night — not a tasting crawl.

name: Wine Country Run (Temecula Half Marathon, 10K, 5K & Kids Run)
blurb: Half marathon, 10K, 5K, and kids run through wine country. Same date as the De Portola harvest celebration — confirm parking.

name: De Portola Wine Trail Harvest Celebration
blurb: Trail-wide harvest day among participating tasting rooms.

name: Shop Small Weekend & Santa’s Arrival
blurb: Thanksgiving weekend shopping plus Santa’s arrival Friday evening. Tasting rooms may run holiday hours on Thursday the 26th — confirm each estate.

name: Temecula Chilled
blurb: Seasonal holiday overlay: lights, dining, and winter programming. Not a single ticketed festival.

name: Peltzer Ice Rink
date: From November 2026 (VTV lists Nov 19 into January 2027)
blurb: Reserved skate sessions. Rink page says closed until November 2026. 21+ bar on site.

name: Holiday Taste of Old Town
blurb: Ticketed tasting stroll. Tickets typically release about a month prior.

name: Santa’s Electric Light Parade
date: December 4, 2026 · 7:00 p.m. (confirm; some calendars say Dec 5)
blurb: Holiday parade. Expect street closures. Poor night for an Old Town tasting walk.

name: New Year’s Eve Grape Drop
blurb: Temecula-style countdown with an East Coast drop at 9 p.m. per Old Town listing.
